newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close at record high, seen climbing.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close at record high, seen climbing.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed on Wednesday at an historic high of 415.93 after a session of heavy trade in a bullish market anticipating a good bourse year in 1997.
Dealers said good medium-term prospects put a brake on selling, although some said there could be a correction in the short term.
The general index gained 6.37 points, 1.56 percent, to 415.93, a record high, while the Ibex-35 rose 82.29 points, 1.74 percent, to 4,815.56.
Telefonica was most active with a 35-peseta gain to 2,970 and 4.18 million shares traded.

"The market continues to be totally in favour. No one wants to sell in light of the good prospects for the coming year," one dealer said. Trading volume was very heavy with more than 77 billion pesetas in business done, nearly 24 billion of it in block trades.
Dealers said there could be more gains on Thursday particularly if Wall Street continued to do well.
In banking, Banesto ended with a 4.25 percent gain, while BBV rose 2.47 percent.
